result.topic_en: A heavily corrected draft of a non-mathematical reply, dated 29 May 1857, to remarks by a Pastor Riemann about compensation for improvements (Melioramente) to church land, including clay pits, the redemption of hunting rights and outstanding lease payments.
result.transcription:

daß diese Pacht [-...-]
Ende Quadragesimä [?] (§ 8.) [-...-] noch nicht verfallen sei, ist nicht stichhaltig, da es (nach § 8. der Verord. {+v. 11 Aug 1801.+} [-...-]) nicht auf die Zeit der Erhebung

items.english: The objection that this lease payment was not yet due at the end of Lent (§ 8) is not valid, since (according to § 8 of the ordinance of 11 Aug 1801) what matters is not the time of collection but the time it falls due.
